title: PR1: rendering cleanup (strip ANSI, filter slash-command lifecycle, render markdown)
description:
First of two PRs improving Evernote note quality. Three concrete rendering bugs observed in example output:

1. ANSI escape codes leak through (e.g. '[1mOpus 4.7[22m' visible in rendered notes) — ESC was stripped upstream but SGR brackets remain
2. Slash command lifecycle messages render as 3-4 separate User messages (<local-command-caveat>, <command-name>, <command-args>, <local-command-stdout>) — should be filtered out entirely
3. Markdown is not converted to ENML — **bold**, ## headings, [link](url), inline code show as literal characters

Approach (per discussion with user, TDD red-green):
- parser.py: filter slash-command lifecycle messages + strip ANSI sequences from extracted message text (clean text in Session.messages — destination-agnostic)
- formatter.py: convert markdown to ENML at render time (destination-specific; the API destination's ENML and the email HTML both benefit)
- Survey daaain/claude-code-log for reusable rendering bits (MIT, Python, same JSONL input format)

Keeps coverage >= 80%, file <= 200 lines, function <= 20 lines, params <= 3, nesting <= 2.

title: Optional LLM bullet-summary block (claude -p)
description:
Deferred from initial discovery-and-rendering work. After per-session note grouping (PR2) lands with embedded JSONL summaries used as titles, evaluate whether the title alone solves note discovery. If we still want a richer summary block at the top of each note, implement an optional 'Tier 2' step:

- Shell out to claude -p '<prompt>' --output-format json on each session at finalization time
- Returns 3-5 bullet summary; embedded at top of the note's ENML body
- Off by default in config; user opts in
- Truncate session to bounded input window (first prompt + last N messages + files touched) so per-call cost stays in the cents-per-month range
- Cache the summary in state so we only call once per session
- Fall back to deterministic header on failure (CLI missing, bucket exhausted, network error)

Cost/billing context (as of 2026):
- Before June 15, 2026: claude -p draws from interactive subscription
- After June 15, 2026: draws from a separate monthly Agent SDK credit (Pro , Max5x , Max20x/Enterprise-Premium-seat ; Enterprise Standard seats NOT eligible)
- Architecture must degrade gracefully when no credit is available

Do not implement until PR1 (rendering cleanup) and PR2 (per-session notes with embedded summary titles) have shipped and Tier 1 has been evaluated in real use.
